notes: Small-portfolio landlord with several vacancies in a Bushwick building reaching out to bring on an agent for leasing. A lead to win. shouldExtractParty=true. Building address gradeable; multiple vacant units but this is a leasing lead (not a broker's multi-listing blast), so grade category/address/neighborhood only, no expectedMultipleOpportunities.

input.subject: Owner with 3 vacancies - looking for a leasing agent
input.bodyText:
Hi Ryan,

I own a small building at 178 Wyckoff Ave in Bushwick and I've got three units turning over at the end of the month - two 2BRs and a 1BR. My previous agent moved out of the area and I need someone reliable to take over leasing.

The 2BRs would go around $3,400/mo and the 1BR around $2,600/mo, renovated. I'd want the same person handling all three and ideally future turnovers too. Are you taking on landlord clients right now? What's your commission for rentals?

Best,
Angela Ruiz
